title: Retries and upstream groups
summary: Upstream groups distribute requests across peers. A successful request to one peer does not prove every route or backend healthy. Retry behavior can hide individual failures.
checks: Compare declared peer contracts over compatible instances and intervals.
limitations: One point sample cannot establish fleet availability or safe retry semantics.
